description: Propose a change to an issued offer on its inspected terms: other quantities (by item index in terms.items), another list of companies (where the items price companies), a delivery date, a total price for the whole, a payment plan, or a note. It is a proposal, not a change: the terms stand and can still be accepted as they are. The business answers it in inspect_offer thread.counteroffers, with a revised offer to inspect and accept, or a reason. A later proposal replaces an earlier one still awaiting an answer. Nothing here orders or pays.

id.description: The request or offer id from your receipt or customer link

name.description: Name of the person making this for the buyer

proposal.description: At least one of quantities, counterparties, deliver_by, total_minor, payment or note

counterparties.description: The companies the order should cover instead, for an offer whose items price companies

identifier.description: An LEI, CIK or registry number, if known

total_minor.description: The total the buyer proposes for the whole, in minor units of the offer currency

terms_sha256.description: Exact terms_sha256 from inspect_offer; the act is refused if the terms have changed since

token.description: Private token from your receipt or customer link; keep it for later visits

name: counter_offer
title: Propose changes to an offer
